perks.name: Primary Honing
perks.description: Increases handling and reload speed for Primary ammo weapons. Primary ammo weapons gain increased damage against non-boss combatants based on your Weapons stat.
perks.exact:
+15 Handling and 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier for Primary Weapons.

Increased Primary Weapon Damage against Non-Boss Combatants based on the Weapons stat.

Compared to the damage dealt at the equivalent Weapons Stat:
20 Stat = 0.6% | 40 = 1.2% | 60 = 1.8% | 80 = 2.4% | 100 = 3%
120 = 4.75% | 140 = 6.6% | 160 = 8.35% | 180 = 10.2% | 200 = 12%

perks.name: Supercyclical
perks.description: Final blows while your Super is active refund Super energy when it ends.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring kills while in a Super Ability:
x1 = ~5?% | x2 = ?% | x3 = ?% | x4 = ?% | x5 = ?% | x6 = ~33% Super Ability Energy once it ends.

Upon scoring kills with Super Damage while NOT in a Super Ability:
x1 = ~5?% | x2 = ?% | x3 = ?% | x4 = ?% | x5 = ?% | x6 = ~33% Super Ability Energy.

Super Ability Refund Cap is reset on Super Ability Cast or upon swaping off of Supercyclical and then reacquiring the 4 Piece Perk by changing gear.
